image_file.description: The path to the output filesystem image file.

source_directory.description: The source directory tree to embed in the image.

ffs_options.description: List of comma-separated FFS-specific options (e.g., 'bsize=4096', 'density=8192'). See man page for valid keywords.

cd9660_options.description: List of comma-separated CD9660/ISO9660-specific options (e.g., 'label=MYCD', 'rockridge'). See man page for valid keywords.

byte_order.description: Byte order: 'big', 'be', 'little', 'le', '4321', or '1234'. Empty string to omit.

minimum_size.description: Minimum size of the image. Decimal bytes, optionally with suffix b/k/m/g/t/w. Empty to omit.

maximum_size.description: Maximum size of the image. Decimal bytes, optionally with suffix b/k/m/g/t/w. Empty to omit.

image_size.description: Fixed size of the image. Decimal bytes, optionally with suffix b/k/m/g/t/w. Empty to omit.

sector_size.description: Sector size in bytes. Defaults to 512.

free_blocks.description: Minimum free blocks. Can include '%' suffix. Empty to omit.

free_files.description: Minimum free files (inodes). Can include '%' suffix. Empty to omit.

userdb_dir.description: Directory containing master.passwd and group files. Empty to use system defaults.

maximum_time.description: Clamp timestamps to this many seconds since Epoch. 0 to omit.

exclude_fs_nodes.description: If true, adds -x to exclude filesystem nodes not in specfile.

specfile.description: Path to mtree specfile. Empty to omit.

debug_mask.description: Debug mask value. Empty to omit.
